# Initialization

dimension 3
boundary p p p
atom_style atomic

create_box 1 box
create_atoms 1 box
mass 1 26.98

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/quenching/brief/subtasks/aluminum_potential_file_subtask_quenching_trial_4/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Settings

thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp press density

# Initial minimization
minimize 1.0e-6 1.0e-8 1000 10000

# NPT relaxation
fix 1 all npt temp 300 300 100 iso 0 0 1000
run 10000

# Output final structure and properties
variable density equal density
print "Final density = ${density}" file density.txt
write_data relaxed_structure.data"}
